recipe.title: Bossman self-repair: command-center/bcc/terminal_cli/cli.py
recipe.symptom: `bossman list tasks --limit N` must return min(N, available) tasks, newest first, without duplicates, even when N exceeds the API's 500 per-request cap (GET /api/tasks offers before_id paging). Small limits and an empty store behave as before. Existing tests must not be weakened.
recipe.cause: CLI list tasks passed limit through; the API clamps to 500 (before_id paging exists). До исправления holdout 4/7; падали: defect: --limit 1000 with 1200 tasks returns 1000, defect: --limit 1500 with 837 tasks returns all 837, defect: --limit 600 with 700 tasks returns 600
recipe.diagnosis: Скрытый holdout cli_task_paging.py на базе 44caf0137861 воспроизводит дефект по результату, а не по наличию проверки.
recipe.action: Исполнитель Bossman (mistral-large/mistralai/mistral-large-4-0, задача mistral91665054): Fix tasks branch to paginate with before_id until the requested limit is met or the store is exhausted, since the API clamps each request to 500. | Изменённые строки:         rows: list[dict] = [] ;         before_id: int | None = None ;         while len(rows) < limit: ;             batch = client.get("/api/tasks", params={"limit": min(limit - len(rows), 500), "before_id": before_id}) or [] ;             if not batch: ;                 break ;             rows.extend(batch) ;             if len(batch) < min(limit - len(rows) + len(batch), 500): ;                 break ;             before_id = batch[-1].get("id") ;         rows = rows[:limit]
recipe.counterexample: Не трогать корректные значения: valid: --limit 20 with 700 tasks returns the newest 20, valid: --limit 500 with 800 tasks returns 500, valid: --limit 1000 with 300 tasks returns 300 once, valid: empty store returns nothing
